reason: The description names both kinds of project: on an Engine project the Skill writes routes that forward the signed-in user's session to the Engine, and on a Supabase project the Supabase auth routes it wrote before.
The workflow transition route is needed only in an app whose `DaaSProvider` has no DaaS URL: from Buildpad UI 3.1.0 `WorkflowButton` posts to the DaaS URL itself.
